title: They Drove a JCB Into the Millennium Dome for a £200M Diamond... That Wasn't Even Real
description:
On November 7th, 2000, a gang smashed a JCB excavator through the fence of London's Millennium Dome, aiming to steal the Millennium Star diamond and eleven flawless blue diamonds worth a combined £350 million. Armed with sledgehammers, a nail gun, and smoke grenades, the four robbers believed they had 90 seconds before police arrived.

What they didn't know: the Flying Squad had been watching them for months after a failed February attempt, undercover officers were posing as cleaners and tourists just feet away, and the real diamond had already been swapped for a replica and hidden in a vault across town. Thirty armed police emerged the moment the nail gun failed to crack the bulletproof case, and even the getaway speedboat driver on the Thames was arrested mid-throttle.

Every member of the gang was caught and convicted. But one mystery remains unsolved to this day: who ordered a £200 million diamond, sight unseen, with no questions asked? That buyer has never been identified.
